name: slice
context_rationale: This skill is interactive — it presents ranked candidates to the user, waits for their pick, may ask a structured confirm gate for bug-fix candidates, and co-derives the slice definition with the user before writing any artifact.
summary: Defines the next thinnest valuable vertical cut by reading the ranked candidate backlog from the unified candidates.json. Presents a ranked recommendation to the user and waits for explicit pick or 'you pick' before proceeding. On agreement, computes worktree paths, creates a git worktree + branch, writes mission-brief.json and milestone.json to the external vault store, claims the picked candidate in candidates.json (status, claimed_by, started_at, pick_log), and auto-advances to /risk-spike (the in-loop spike gate).

methodology_tools.name: stranded_slice_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: Classify every unmerged slice/* branch into a 4-class divergence model to detect stranded/orphaned prior work before defining a new slice.

methodology_tools.name: risk_register_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: Return scored, sorted open risk candidates instead of a raw grep for HIGH/active entries.

methodology_tools.name: _worktree_paths
methodology_tools.purpose: Compute canonical worktree path and branch name — single source of truth shared with /build-slice and branch_workflow_audit.

methodology_tools.name: candidates_top
methodology_tools.purpose: Rank the live candidates.json backlog (blocked-on-spike + unmet-deps flagged) for the Step 1 recommendation.

methodology_tools.name: claim_candidate
methodology_tools.purpose: SVW-1 atomic claim: set status=spiking / progress=spike / claimed_by / started_at / slice + history + pick_log.

name: design-slice
context_rationale: This skill asks up to 4 clarifying questions interactively when real design ambiguity exists, and its design output is anchored to the live conversation context with the user; it also calls /critique via Skill tool as auto-advance.
summary: Produces a just-enough per-slice design (design.json) by querying code-review-graph for blast-radius and reachability context, consulting the ephemeral project-frame synthesizer, identifying only what is new for this slice, asking <=4 clarifying questions when genuinely ambiguous, and tagging every new ADR with reversibility. In Heavy mode it also updates threat-model.json and cost-estimation.json. Completes by updating milestone.json and auto-advancing to /critique.

methodology_tools.name: project_frame_synth
methodology_tools.purpose: Emit an ephemeral <=40-line project-frame (Identity / Trajectory / Impact) so the design is direction-aware before any writing begins; advisory, never a gate.

name: repro
context_rationale: This skill asks clarifying questions interactively when the issue description is vague, relies on the user to confirm reproduction steps and environment, and its output (failing test path) feeds directly into the calling /slice session's BFRD-1 gate.
summary: Establishes a FAILING test that reproduces a bug before any fix code is written, codifying the tests-first-for-bug-fixes discipline. Parses the issue description (asking <=3 clarifying questions if vague), queries code-review-graph for context in the buggy code area, writes a runnable test under tests/bugs/, confirms it actually fails with the expected signature, then appends a shippability.json entry via scripts.lib.vault_edit append so the bug can never silently return. Hands off to /slice for the fix slice.
